name: Pack Mule
tagline: Shipping software for people who resent shipping software.
positioning: Pack Mule runs the pickups, routes, and label chaos for small-batch makers who ship real things and would rather be making them.

hero.h1: You make it. We haul it. Nobody cries.
hero.sub: Pack Mule handles pickups, routing, and the label printer that hates you — so you can go back to the workshop instead of refreshing the carrier dashboard at 11pm.

features.title: Routes that respect physics
features.description: Batch every day's orders into pickup runs that account for your van, your fragile inventory, and the one bridge that's always closed.

features.title: Labels without the séance
features.description: One screen for every carrier. Print, reprint, and void without summoning three browser tabs and a support ticket.

features.title: Live tracking customers trust
features.description: Branded tracking pages that tell the truth about where the crate is, so your inbox stops filling with 'is it here yet' emails.

features.title: Damage claims, filed for you
features.description: When a carrier flattens a box, Pack Mule pulls the photos, files the claim, and chases the refund while you keep working.

features.title: Rates you can actually read
features.description: Compare real landed cost across carriers per shipment — no fuel-surcharge riddles, no surprise dimensional weight.

features.title: Runs on a laptop and a wish
features.description: Built for one-person shops and five-person crews. No forklift, no warehouse management degree, no IT department required.

testimonials.quote: We ship 40 crates of ceramics a week. Pack Mule cut our packing-desk time in half and the breakage claims basically file themselves now. I got my Sundays back.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

testimonials.quote: Before this I had a spreadsheet, three carrier logins, and a personality problem. Now I have one screen and a slightly better attitude.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feeley

testimonials.quote: The tracking pages alone killed our 'where is my order' emails. Our two-person shop looks like we have a logistics team. We do not.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
